description: An editorial match-dossier baseline for Vietnamese soccer analysis in vertical video.
primary_publishing_shape: Short-form vertical video; platform publishing and platform-specific adaptations are not configured in this package.
renderer_requirement: Use the asymmetric chapter rail, distinct portrait tactical plate, warm brass/coral accents, numbered shirt symbols, color-coded vectors, and sparse Vietnamese copy. No rounded dashboard card or persistent subtitles. Keep match photos and footage in approved Asset Library slots.
change_policy: No per-content edits to locked design. Changes require a new package version and explicit owner review.
